title: EMOTE AND CLOSED RING LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps callout of at most 34 characters, never a sentence. The review of the sixth batch of raid text found the emote, closed ring and bystander lines still written as sentences. The hail now says NOT WHILE DOWN, NOT WHILE ROLLING, LOWER YOUR GUN TO TALK and NOBODY IN EARSHOT, and a pillager answers by name in caps: NAME WILL NOT TALK, NAME STANDS DOWN or NAME WAVES BACK (the longest tag keeps each within 34), and NOTHING TO SPARE with his name as the detail. E in a closed ring says EXTRACTION A IS CLOSED with the nearest open one, its distance and its direction as the detail, still once per visit. A survivor or the Peddler killed by someone else is SOMEONE SHOT THE SURVIVOR or THE PEDDLER IS DEAD, with Not on you. or Someone else did that. as the detail. No rule moved.
now: The emote, closed ring and bystander lines read as short caps callouts, such as NOBODY IN EARSHOT and EXTRACTION A IS CLOSED.
